name: Red Linen Goods
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The Defias gang in Northshire wears burlap masks, but the Defias in Elwynn wear linen which I can use to make fine linen goods.

Bring me red linen bandanas and I'll use them to fashion something for you.

Defias gang members have camps pocketed throughout Elwynn.
narrative.objectives: Bring 6 Red Linen Bandanas to Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, these are nice bandanas, if a little rough...

Here you are!
narrative.requestItemsText: I'm running low on linen, adventurer. Do you have any for me?
